about_the_game:
Explore Central Asia and liberate your homeland from invaders. Feel like a true Turkish warrior. Experience flawless archery and swordsmanship. In this graphically ambitious game, you’ll feel as if you’re truly there.


Erlik Han has declared war on the earth, and if he gets what he wants, it could mean the end of the world. Villages are being burned and destroyed one by one. Evil is slowly engulfing the entire realm.

💠Survival Mechanic💠

🔵You’ll need to gather resources and set up camp to survive, with highly realistic survival dynamics.

🔵Hunt to satisfy your hunger.

🔵Build a camp to rest, but will the campsite be as safe as it seems?

⚜️Unique Magical Power⚜️

🟡Each boss has unique powers you can claim!

🟡Solve mysteries to unlock unique spells inspired by mythology.

🔰Breathtaking Stor🔰

🟢While rooted entirely in Turkish mythology, the story includes fictional elements.

🟢The realistic narrative structure is largely drawn from books about Central Asian Turks.

🌍Open World and Beyon🌍

🟣The open world is filled with mysteries and locations inspired by Turkish mythology.

🟣Unique region designs: each boss area is crafted to immerse you in its world.

🟣Mongol outposts, taking advantage of the disaster to plunder the land, can be destroyed.


You might be the only hope!

and more...
Gameplay video: July 12, 2025

content_descriptors.notes: It only contains the elements of violence brought by realistic combat mechanics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 30 FPS at 1080p resolution.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or equivalent (e.g., AMD Ryzen 7 3700X)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (8 GB VRAM) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 60 FPS at 1080p / 1440p resolution with high settings

short_description: Join this epic adventure set in ancient Central Asia, inspired by Turkish mythology! Face mythological creatures while exploring this breathtaking open world. Take part in the war among the Tengris and save your realm.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Turkish*, French
*languages with full audio support
